programme.desc: Dans une ville dévastée par l'armée allemande, des soldats russes déterminés se battent pour maintenir leur position dans un immeuble stratégique et se lient d'amitié avec une compatriote.

programme.title: Pour elle
programme.desc: Inspiré d'une histoire vraie, la vie de Mara s'effondre lorsque son ex-mari enlève leur jeune fille et s'enfuit au Moyen-Orient. Déterminée à la ramener à la maison, elle s'allie à Robeson, un ancien Marine spécialiste des cas d'enfants enlevés.

programme.title: L'Appel de la Chair
programme.desc: Jeune actrice de comédie musicale, Laura se désespère de sa situation : elle sort d'une opération liée à son cancer, doit retourner vivre dans la maison de son enfance, et son compagnon Jacob vient de la quitter. Sa vie bascule encore davantage lorsqu'elle découvre qu'un monstre vit désormais chez elle.

programme.title: Totem
programme.desc: Buffle, un ancien scout, n'a toujours pas fait le deuil de son ami disparu il y a vingt ans. En plus de cela, il est constamment hanté par un rat géant… Sa psychologue lui conseille de reformer sa bande en organisant un camp. Mais cette thérapie de groupe va prendre une nouvelle dimension lorsque que nos quadragénaires vont découvrir un passage temporel.

programme.title: La Mort Caresse à Minuit
programme.desc: Top model en vogue pour une agence italienne, Valentina essaie une toute nouvelle drogue proche du LSD. Au cours de sa traversée psychédélique, elle assiste à un meurtre d'une cruauté surprenante. Persuadée que cet assassinat n'est pas que le fruit de son imagination, elle se met en quête de l'assassin.

programme.title: Wicked City
programme.desc: Dans un monde où humains et démons coexistent secrètement, une unité spéciale veille à maintenir la paix entre les deux espèces. Taki, un agent humain, et Makie, une envoûtante femme-démon, sont chargés de protéger un diplomate clé lors de négociations cruciales.

programme.title: L'Œil du Labyrinthe
programme.desc: Jeune et jolie, Julie suit une thérapie auprès du docteur Luca Berti, un homme séduisant qui est non seulement son psychiatre mais aussi son amant. Un matin, elle se réveille brusquement après avoir rêvé de sa mort.

programme.title: Hautes Fréquences

programme.desc: Après un crash dans le désert, une botaniste est retenue captive par un trafiquant de drogue.

programme.title: Continental Split
programme.desc: Une faille menace de diviser les États-Unis. Une équipe doit empêcher la catastrophe.

programme.title: Lord of Drug
programme.desc: Michael a 12 heures pour traverser la frontière avec de la drogue et sauver son épouse kidnappée.

Avec ses amis Alex et Money, elle a déjà commis quelques cambriolages, mais rien qui leur rapporte assez pour enfin quitter Détroit. Lorsque le trio entend parler d'un aveugle qui vit en solitaire et garde chez lui une petite fortune, ils préparent ce qu'ils pensent être leur ultime coup. Mais leur victime va se révéler bien plus effrayante, et surtout bien plus dangereuse que ce à quoi ils s'attendaient…

programme.title: Don't Breathe 2

programme.title: Traque Sur Internet
programme.desc: Angela Bennett, une jeune analyste du reseau Internet, va se retrouver malgré elle au coeur d'un réseau de terrorisme informatique.

Pointing to Sonya as her new mistress, she tells the cosmonaut she can make her every wish come true.When the plane on which Sonya is scheduled to return leaves, Tony feels her country now has possession of a decisive secret weapon. Sonya agrees to return the bottle if Tony marries her. Tony asks a last word with Jeannie. He tells Jeannie he can't marry Sonya. Jeannie solves the problem by creating a duplicate Tony for Sonya.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E8
programme.desc: Feeling that Jeannie must widen her horizons, Tony gives her a book "How To Be A Woman." Following the book's advice, to share her work with her man, Jeannie neglects her chores and allows the house to go to pot. Reading the chapter on clothing the successful woman, Jeannie charges an expensive wardrobe, in-cluding a mink coat. Convinced by the book that a man should take the woman out to dinner, Jeannie steers Tony to expensive Cafe Scheherazade. She starts a row when she criticizes the authen-ticity of the Arabian dancing.Literally taking the author's advice, Jeannie becomes a career girl and performs miraculous feats of instantaneous cooking while demonstrating electric stoves. Her employer, Sam, feeling she has been planted to get him into trouble with the Better Business Bureau, fires her. Later, after Tony feels he has straightened out things at home, Jeannie hears a news report about the flight of a Russian female astronaut. Blinking her eyes, she is outfitted as an astronaut and insists on accompanying Tony into space.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E1
programme.desc: Captain Tony Nelson, an astronaut, is engaged to Melissa Stone, daughter of General Wingard Stone, his commanding officer. Tony is rocketed into space in a capsule which lands is the Pacific. He reaches a small island. There he releases Jeannie, a beautiful blonde, who can perform magic with a blink of her eyes, from a bottle is which she has been imprisoned for ages. Jeannie tells Tony she is his slave forever. Worried about Jeannie's effect on Melissa and his career, Tony tries to leave Jeannie behind on the island, but she smuggles herself aboard the rescue plan. Questioned about his reactions in space by the base psychiatrist, Dr. Alfred Bellows, Tony tells about his meeting with Jeannie. Feeling that Tony is suffering from hallucinations, Bellows calls General Stone.Jeannie appears at Tony's home. Tony tries frantically to keep General Stone, Melissa, Doctor Bellows and Captain Roger Henley, a fellow astronaut, from seeing Jeannie. His problems reach a climax when Jeannie produces a harem of dancing girls to perform for Tony. After Tony works his way out of that, Melissa and her father leave, feeling a vacation, combined with a honeymoon, will solve Tony's problems. Tony orders Jeannie to leave no doubt that she is determined to be a part of Tony's life for a long time.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E9
programme.desc: Tony is assigned as technical director on a new astronaut movie being filmed in Hollywood. Jealous of the star, Rita Mitchell, Jeannie smuggles herself along. All of Jeannie's ruses, including a rainstorm, fail to keep Tony from getting close to Rita. Tony tells Jeannie he is lunching with Rita and jokingly tells Jeannie he would lunch with her instead if she were a star. Determined to become a movie celebrity, Jeannie, seeing a picture of Pola Negri, patterns her personality on the old-time vamp.Although her first try at getting into the movies is viewed as a gag, Jeannie manages to get a screen test with Jason Huberts, which arouses Tony's jealousy. When the test with Jason and Jeannie is shown, only Jason is visible and Jeannie suddenly realizes that genies do not register on film. She is consoled when Tony breaks a date with Rita and they register their footprints in front of Grauman's Chinese with all the movie greats.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S1E16
programme.desc: The members of the Hospital Fund Auxiliary appoint Samantha Entertainment Chairman for the group's bazaar. Limited to spending fifty dollars, Samantha hires Zeno, a broken down magician who has taken to drink. Because of this, his assistant, Roxie Ames, has left the act. Using her gift of magic, Samantha makes Zeno the hit of the show. As a result, Zeno gets a job on TV. Zeno pleads with Samantha to help him. Assisted by Samantha, Zeno runs through a very successful rehearsal. Just before the show goes on the air, Roxie appears and injects herself into the act. Hogging the show, Roxie kills Zeno' s act and his con-fidence. She admits she returned just to get a regular spot on TV herself. Samantha turns Roxie into a comic prop for Zeno. After Zeno's successful performance, Darrin tells Samantha that his client has booked Zeno for the next thirteen weeks. Darrin attempts some magic on his own. When he succeeds, he is not certain whether his skill or Samantha's is responsible.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S1E10
programme.desc: Endora tells Samantha that Maurice, her father, is coming to visit. Endora warns Samantha that Maurice will be furious when he learns his daughter has married a mortal. Samantha, determined to stand up to her father, gets Darrin to stay in town on the night Maurice calls. Samantha tells Maurice that her husband is in Washington. The conversation about Darrin proceeds nicely until Maurice surmises Darrin is a mortal. Meanwhile, Darrin, who has been drinking with Larry Tate, phones Samantha and tells her he is coming home. When Darrin arrives, Maurice's fury hits its peak. Al-though Maurice admires Darrin's courage in facing up to him, he makes him disappear. Samantha, expressing her love for Darrin, pleads with Maurice to bring him back. Even Endora joins in Samantha's pleas. Although he tells them it will be extremely difficult, Maurice makes Darrin reappear. Before leaving, Maurice joins his family in a champagne toast. Im-pressed by the rare vintage, Maurice feels Darrin might be one of them after all.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S1E21
programme.desc: Darrin's agency is unable to find a model for the "Jewel of the East" campaign. Darrin hopes they'll be able to do so, if only to bolster the confidence of Wally Ames, who is sub-stituting for the company's top photographer. Samantha trans-forms the Stephens' cat into a beautiful Oriental girl named Ling Ling. Everyone flips over her and the campaign is wrapped up. Darrin invites Larry and Louise Tate and Wally to a victory celebration at his home. Wally, intrigued by Ling Ling's feline grace, brings her along. Samantha's efforts to make Ling Ling give up Wally fail. To avoid a catastrophe, Samantha is forced to tell Darrin and asks him to warn Wally off, but Wally only becomes angry with Darrin. Samantha spikes Ling Ling's drink with truth serum. Wally bows out when Ling Ling displays her true cat nature. Later, Gladys Kravitz calls her husband when she sees Ling Ling clad in a mink coat, lapping milk from a saucer. By the time Abner gets to the window, Samantha has returned Ling Ling to her original state, and Abner gives his wife a spoonful of her nerve medicine.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S1E6
programme.desc: Darrin discovers that Samantha has been entertaining a guest each morning after he leaves for work. the guest is ten year old Marshall Burns. Darrin tells Samantha that she has no right to interfere with Mrs. Burns' upbringing of her son. Despite Marshall's belief that he is no good at anything, Samantha takes him to a Junior League ball game. Marshall has never been able to make the team. Floyd Kravitz, nephew of Gladys Kravitz, is the star player. With a little witchery on Samantha's part, Marshall becomes a triple threat. When his mother, fearful that he may be inured, forbids him to play, Marshall runs away from home. Samantha and Darrin drive Mrs. Burns to the ball field. There, Marshall, in his own right, has continued to star. How-ever, when Marshall gets into a tight spot, Darrin forbids Samantha from interfering. Marshall makes it on his own. Proud of her son, Mrs. Burns is not unhappy when Coach Gribben suggests that he visit the Burns home to give Marshall some extra coaching.

The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: Wild Waters

Life on these freshwater freeways can be tough, and for many it's a constant battle just to stay alive. programme.title: Hot Roads
programme.sub-title: The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads - S2 E05
programme.desc: The Canadian ice roads exist only for a few months in the winter when the ice is thick enough. The only time of the year when goods can be transported up to Northern Manitoba. We accompany the truckers Vlad and Hugh as well as the aboriginal Canadian Scott with his pick-up on their long journey to a village called God's Lake. A risky trip in icy temperatures, sometimes even below - 60 degrees Celcius. The men are in constant danger of getting stuck and need to forget everything they ever learnt about driving on a highway in order to arrive safely.

programme.title: Predators of a Different Kind
programme.sub-title: In the World of the Unknown Sharks
programme.desc: With the aid of modern technology, reveal the unknown behaviour of some unusual species of shark: lemon sharks and their white-tip reef counterparts. Our film trip begins on the Bahamas. To be more precise: in the turquoise-blue waters of the Grand Bahama Bank, in an exactly fixed location. In the spring, 70 – 80 pregnant lemon sharks arrive here. This huge shark population was first discovered just a few years ago by shark researcher, Professor Sam Gruber. Many of the females are tired and rest on the seabed. Pregnant tiger sharks swim in the midst of this group. Without any protection whatsoever, our cameramen shoot their footage, surrounded by sharks and succeed in capturing images hitherto unseen. We continue our journey to Gainesville, Florida, to meet Gordon Hubbell, the leading shark denture expert with the world's largest shark denture collection. He knows everything about the evolutionary history of the lemon sharks, in addition to those of the white-tip reef variety off Cocos Island, Costa Rica. Here, we encounter large schools of fish, unprecedented numbers of stingrays, as well as hammerhead sharks. However, it is the white-tip reek sharks that make the biggest impression. Their performance begins late at night. Marauding, they patrol in large groups through the reefs and hunt everything that moves. Scales and dead prey fish float above the reef – a welcoming change of diet for the ubiquitous barracudas.

programme.title: Eyes Of The Atacama

programme.title: mareTV: Majorca
programme.desc: "Cleaning woman island", concrete castles, Ballermann: Mallorca's image is negatively affected in some respects. The documentary explores the charm of the largest Balearic island beyond the hustle and bustle of tourism and Rambazamba. The "real" Mallorca is best explored through real Majorcans: Manolo Barahona, TV fishing expert from the local island broadcaster IB3, faces the most difficult task of the year. The Raor is in season, the most expensive fish on the island. Manolo is supposed to get him first in front of the camera and then in the pan. There's only one catch, the little fish with the piranha teeth just doesn't want to be on TV. In the first months of the year Mallorca turns into a sea of almond blossoms. There are around seven million almond trees on the island, once planted to replace dead vines. But now also the almond trees are threatened. programme.title: The marvellous World of French Rivers
programme.desc: The Gironde is the largest and most powerful tidal current in Europe. When the Gironde flows into the Atlantic, it is 15 kilometers wide and in the rhythm of the tides, it brings the waters from the Pyrenees and the Massif Central into the ocean. This often pushes its waters far out into the Gironde at high tide.This creates a world of its own that has shaped everything uniquely and intensely for tens of thousands of years. The water surface of the river is so large that the evaporation has created its own microclimate, which is stable and, together with the brackish waters, has influenced flora and fauna on the right and left of the bank for a long time.

programme.title: The marvellous World of French Rivers

Jonathan lands in Manila to discover the top chefs are well aware of the issue and, following their advice, he launches off on an expedition to find part of the solution. Driving from headhunting tribal villages, to step-back-in-time colonial towns, to restaurants in the shadow of the American military behemoth an intriguing story slowly pieces together. After a harrowing escape on the Bounty, Wu tells the Ninja they weren't his first pupils!

programme.title: Ghost Story
programme.desc: When Moro gives chase to the Bounty and steals Wu's staff, Wu shares the story of Moro: the boy who wanted to be the Green Ninja – and the Ninja discover Wu's staff contained 3 symbols that lead to the Tomb of the First Spinjitzu Master which holds a mysterious relic that could alter the course of Ninjago. Moro gives chase to the Bounty and steals Wu's staff, leaving them to crash. When the dust settles, Wu shares the story of Moro: the boy who wanted to be the Green Ninja. They discover Wu's staff contained 3 symbols that lead to the Tomb of the First Spinjitzu Master which holds a mysterious relic that could alter the course of Ninjago. In order to save Lloyd and get their powers back, they set off to find the first clue – the scroll to the lost martial art of ‘Airjitzu'. On their way to get it, they have a run in with one of Moro's ghost generals Wraythe, and discover water is the key to stopping them. Meanwhile, Nya discovers a family secret – her mother was a Water Ninja and with training, she could be one too.

programme.title: Saturday Knight Fever
programme.desc: The Book of Monsters catching a cold means trouble for the NEXO-Knights when he can create an entirely new kind of “snotty” monster. King and Queen Halbert have journeyed to the town of Cleanington to open the brand new Scrubbery Barn at the invitation of Roger the Scrubber (seen in 104.) Meanwhile, the Book of Monsters drags Jestro to Snottingham – one of the coldest places in Knighton where everyone coughs, has a runny nose and is generally under-the-weather. The BOM demands that Jestro feed him a “snotheiser” ball which will probably make him sick. The BOM explains that if he is sick, he may just produce a whole new breed of magical monsters … some that the knights would NEVER expect. The BOM gets sick and starts coughing up phlegm globlins and bloblins. The Knights arrive, alerted to what they think is an attack on the town by Snottingham's mayor, Hack Coughmeier. The sickened, sneezy, snotty monsters infect the knights and, more importantly, the knights' NEXO-Shields. Now their NEXO-Powers are infected. As they try to download something to fight the monsters, they realize the powers they get are off strange, infected versions of their powers. The knights drive Jestro and his snot monsters off and they turn in for the night. And, overnight, they all get sick. Meanwhile, the BOM order a nice, hot lava bath…he'll feel fine by morning. But the knights wake-up with colds and they feel terrible. Ava and Merlok 2.0 thinks it will pass in a day or two…it's just a typical Snottingham cold. Each knight gets sick in their own funny way and their illnesses play right into Jestro and the BOM's hands: they're headed to Cleanington to kidnap the king! The citizens of the ultra-clean city hate the sight of monsters, but then feel caught in between when the sick, sneezy, snotty knights arrive on their Fortrex. The fight goes terribly for the knights. They try to download the Nexo-power “Glorious Griffon” but instead get just feathers. So they improvise and tickle the monsters! Ava finally comes up with a way to use some anti-virus tools on their NEXO-Shields and just as Jestro is about to take the king and queen away, the NEXO-Knights get their normal powers back! They defeat Jestro and save the king and queen.

programme.title: Open Mike Knight
programme.desc: The Book of Betrayal leads Jestro and his Monsters to Funnyton – the funnies town in the kingdom. When they Knights arrive to capture him, they discover (to their shock) that Jestro and the Book of Monsters are now the town's top comedians! Jestro and his monsters are in attack formation moving to pillage the town of Funnyton. But when they arrive, ready to tear into the place, they see that nobody's in town. Then, they hear…laughter?! The entire town is there listening to a stand-up comic JOKES KNIGHTLY. He's hilarious. He commands such power, such attention, and such loyalty. Jestro and the BOM decide they must become funny. They order all kinds of book on comedy from Spamazon: books on parody, irony, insult humor, slapstick, satire, knock-knock jokes, elephant jokes, “my monster is so fat” jokes, etc. They work-up a ventriloquist act with the BOM sitting on Jestro's lap. They start doing their act and, surprisingly, they're funny. They're very funny. The Fortrex arrives and the knights rush out, ready for battle. They fight through a string of monsters just outside the town, but discover they're only working as “bouncers” to keep too many people out of the comedy club. (“Sorry, you guys aren't on the list.”) The knights hear loud laughs and head there. In the club, they discover the town isn't being held hostage, they're in the show voluntarily having a great time. And…Jestro and the BOM are funny. Meanwhile, during the show, Jokes Knightly decides he'll steal the BOM and Jestro's act. During the intermission at the comedy show, Clay comes backstage to talk to Jestro. Maybe, Clay says, this shows that Jestro doesn't have to be bad…he is funny, like Clay always said he was. Meanwhile, Jokes Knightly steals the BOM and Jestro can't find it. He panics. Clay encourages him…go on stage alone, be funny…he can do it! Jestro goes out and is funny on his own he hits all his punchlines, he gets big laughs he starts to see that Clay is right. The BOM sees that Jokes Knightly has a “joke book” that turns out to be the BOOK OF BETRAYAL. That's how Mike Knight has become so funny – by stealing everyone's material! BOM calls in Magmar, who saves him from Mike Knight AND takes the Book of Betrayal. As Jestro comes off-stage to great applause, the BOM tells him they have the Book of Betrayal. The BOM calls in Magmar and his monsters and they start a fight as Clay comes to Jestro's defense and calls on the other Knights for backup. A big battle ensues that destroys the comedy club in Funnyton. The Knights win and drive-off Magmar, the monsters and the BOM. As they retreat, the BOM looks around: “Where's my Jestro?!” Jestro sneaked away during the fight and is in a nearby forest with…the Book of Betrayal.

programme.title: The Fortrex And The Furious
programme.desc: In a massive chase around Knighton, the NEXO-Knights attempt to keep the Book of Betrayal out of the Book of Monster's grip. But the evil book is persistent. Will he get the final piece of his evil puzzle? We finally REVEAL that Jestro has given the Book of Betrayal to…Clay. He tells Clay what it is and how Mike Knight used it. And it seems that the Book of Monsters believed it to be the final ingredient in some ‘Master Plan.” Suddenly, they realize Monsters – led by Magmar and the super-mad Book of Monster – are after them! Clay retreats with Jestro and the Book of Betrayal to rendezvous with the other Knights at the Fortrex. The Fortrex isn't fast enough they'll need their own vehicles. They decide that they need to split up and go in multiple directions to make the monsters expend their resources on a chase. It's a huge chase, being covered like a crazy news event by the Knighton News Network. We see a montage of the monsters stopping and capturing all the Knights vehicles: Aaron, Macy, Lance…finally Axl. However, as they do, they realize that the Knights have used Squirebots in Jestro Fan Jester hats (from the vendor at the comedy club in 108) as decoys. They think Axl has the Book of Betrayal in his BRICK containment unit, but it turns out to be the Ned Knightly Comic from episode 203. The Monsters finally corner Clay, who has the real Jestro and Book of Betrayal in his sword vehicle. Before Clay can protest, Jestro pushes the launch button and fires off Clay in the vehicle's rocket sword. The monsters race off with Jestro, leaving the shocked Clay fearing for his friend. Now, Magmar tells the Book of Monsters, they only need to get BOB. Clay makes his way back to the Fortrex and tells what has happened. They decide they must get to the Redoubt of Ruination in the Lava Lands and try to save Jestro. Meanwhile, we see, INTERCUT, a scene where Merlok 2.0 and the Book of Monsters explain the Books of Evil, how they were created and what the BOM will use them for. Merlok, back in the day, split the evil MONSTRUX into 10 magic books to keep him from ever being a threat. Only, he didn't destroy the books…and now the BOM has them and Monstrux can come back into the world! Meanwhile, the BOM has set up the huge, ceremonial arena at their HQ so they can have the ceremony to bring Monstrux back into the world. Jestro realizes he's been a pawn of the Book of Monsters. Jestro says he'll never get the Book of Betrayal…the Knights have it. In the last scene, we see Clay taking the Book of Betrayal from the Fortrex, climbing into his vehicle and driving towards…the Redoubt of Ruination! Has the Book of Betrayal worked its evil magic on him?!

programme.title: Kingdom Of Heroes
programme.desc: The Book of Monsters, having the final pieces of his evil plan in place, tries to take human form. Can the NEXO-Knights and Merlok 2.0 stop the greatest threat they've ever faced? Or will the kingdom be plunged into darkness…forever. The Redoubt of Ruination readies the final ceremony to call forth MONSTRUX, the arch-necromancer of the past. Clay, holding the Book of Betrayal walks to the gates of the spooky place. Inside, Clay hears strange…singing and music. It's like a twisted Broadway show of some kind. Meanwhile, the Knights all realize Clay is gone and so is the Book of Betrayal. Macy says Clay must be up to something. They have to trust him and, more importantly, they have to find him. At the Redoubt of Ruination the ceremony has already begun! The Book of Monsters wants the final ceremony that calls forth Monstrux to be like a really great show! The BOM then barfs up all the BOOKS OF EVIL into their places around Jestro. He's just missing the BOOK OF BETRAYAL, which Clay has. Clay says he'll trade the book for Jestro. The BOM immediately agrees to the deal and sets Jestro free. Then, Monsters grab-up Clay, restrain him, and put him in Jestro's place on the sacrifice stone. From outside, they're interrupted by the sounds of battle the Knights have arrived on the Fortrex and are attacking the Redoubt of Ruination. In the confusion, Jestro slips away. The BOM lets loose with a powerful protection spell to keep the Knights out as he starts with the ceremony…he's going to bring Monstrux out and remanifest him in Clay's body! Jestro is able to escape the Redoubt and make his way to the Knights, who can't seem to battle their way in. It's a race against time as the Knights try to get in and save Clay. As the Knights get in, they see that the crazy BOM is absorbing all the Books of Evil, one-by-one. He grows BIGGER and BIGGER! Macy calls for NEXO-Power…but it's not enough! The gigantic Book of Monsters sucks down the final book, the Book of Betrayal! He looms over Clay, about to consume him, too, and make him into Monstrux! Suddenly, Robin appears carrying TECHKALIBER…he tosses it to Clay. Just as the huge Book of Monsters falls on Clay, he holds up Techkaliber and Merlok 2.0 is there…his full power in the sword. Clay sticks the sword into the Book of Monster's huge mouth. BOOM! There's a BIG, MAGICAL EXPLOSION! As we cut back inside, we see the Book of Monsters is gone. The Knights release Clay and he thanks them and Jestro for saving him. Jestro thanks them all for saving him and seeing the good in him. WE DISSOLVE TO: The JoustDome. In a final ceremony the King and Queen reward the knights and congratulate them for keeping the kingdom safe. There are speeches, happiness and friendship. And Jestro even does a bit that's funny. At the very end we see a hint of something…Monstrux and the Book of Monsters are still out there.

programme.title: Versus

programme.title: Laal Banarasi
programme.desc: The story highlights the exploitation happening with the ‘Bunkars' in Banaras, whose craft is appreciated all around the world, but they are paid peanuts by the traders. Amidst this, blooms a love story between the two opposites - Gauri, a bunkar and Garv, a trader. The story is of Gauri who belongs to the bunkar community facing series of incidents which destroys her family and swears to bring about a change in their life and stop the exploitation by directly trading the sarees. This becomes a battle with traders creating hurdles in her life but she is unstoppable.

programme.title: Dharmakshetra
programme.desc: As The Great War Of Mahabharata Is Over, Kurukshetra Lies Barren In Its Great Warriors And King. The Thin Line Between Fair And Unfair, Deceit And Loyalty, Betrayal And Duty, Has Never Been Questioned. Dharmakshetra Resurfaces These Buried Questions And Allows The Legendary Characters Of This Tale An Opportunity To Tell Their Side Of The Story For The Very First Time. In A Post-Apocalyptic Trial, Held In Maharaj Chitragupta'S Court, The Seeming Villains ‘Kauravas' Are Allowed To Accuse The So Called Heroes ‘Pandavas' And Vice Versa, In An Attempt To Justify Their Actions. On A Primary Level, Dharamkshetra Attempts To Ask Some Key Questions About The Nature Of Humanity, While At The Same Time, It Puts Together The Forgotten Pieces Of The Story We Thought We Knew.

programme.title: Dahej Daasi
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: Agni Vayu
programme.desc: Agni Vayu Is A Romantic Thriller That Tells The Story Of A Young, Vibrant Dr. Agni And An Ambitious Investment Banker Vayu. As Their Love Blossoms, An Unfortunate Turn Of Events Happens That Throws Them Amid Conspiracy, Misunderstanding, Swindling, And All Sorts Of Paradoxes At Every Turn. They Set Out On A Journey To Unravel The Mystery Surrounding These Events. Can They Both Solve It Together And Will They Disclose Their Feelings To Each Other During The Journey.

programme.title: Maata Ki Mahima
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: Beti Hamari Anmol
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: Yam Kisi Se Kam Nahin
programme.desc: A misfit, a God, a husband, and a breadwinner, Yamraj is a common man with a fancy job title. He tries his best to give his family what they need and manages to make a mess of everything in the bargain. Lovable and goofy, this God of Death is anything but grim. Join our hardworking but hen-pecked Yamraj, his beloved buffalo and his motely family and friends in a slice-of-life sitcom to find out how the cookie really crumbles!

programme.title: Netanagri
programme.desc: This week on Neta Nagari, Siddhant Mohan discusses the challenges facing the Modi government, the Delimitation Bill, and Prashant Kishor's victory. The episode also looks at the political battle between Vijay and Udhayanidhi in Tamil Nadu.

programme.title: The Lallantop
programme.desc: In today's Lallantop Show, Kuldeep covers Gen Alpha student protests in Lucknow, Rajasthan's new school guidelines restricting outsiders, and BJP President Nitin Nabin's new team with Vasundhara Raje as Vice President. We also discuss the Supreme Court's refusal to interfere in the Ram Mandir donation theft SIT probe and its interim relief to Rahul Gandhi.

programme.title: Duniyadari
programme.desc: Trump has ordered the US military to reduce joint drills with South Korea, calling the exercises 'hostile' to North Korea while praising his 'very good relationship' with Kim Jong Un. We also cover Iran's $30,000 bounty for killing US soldiers, Kushner's talks with Hamas in Egypt, and Russia's missile strike on ArcelorMittal's plant in Ukraine that killed two workers.

programme.title: Kharcha Pani
programme.desc: India's Chief Economic Adviser has called for bringing back E10 petrol alongside E20, warning that India's 7.5–8 crore older two-wheelers could be at risk. But beyond vehicles, the debate also raises a bigger question: as India uses more maize for ethanol, could this hurt edible oil production and poultry feed—creating a new Food vs Fuel problem?

programme.title: Rajdhani
programme.desc: BJP President Nitin Nabin has unveiled his new national team, bringing Smriti Irani back as National General Secretary with charge of Uttar Pradesh and naming Ram Madhav and Vasundhara Raje Scindia among 13 National Vice Presidents. We break down the major appointments, the leaders who returned, and the prominent names missing from the list, including Amit Malviya's exit as IT Cell chief.

programme.title: Sehat
programme.desc: In today's Sehat show, Dr. Ajay Kumar breaks down the early warning signs of hepatitis and how to protect your liver, while Dr. Vikas Maurya shares essential monsoon health tips. We also discuss the best diet to fight seasonal flu and when to see a doctor.

programme.title: The Cinema Show
programme.desc: Awarapan 2 crushed Bantwara 1947 at the box office, with Emraan Hashmi's film collecting Rs 81.75 crore in its opening weekend against Sunny Deol's Rs 26.50 crore . Also in this episode: Avengers: Doomsday gets a special trailer, Johnny Depp may return as Jack Sparrow in Pirates of the Caribbean 6 , and Ramayana producer Namit Malhotra responds to the AI lip-sync controversy .

programme.title: Ghoom Ghaam
programme.desc: Ghoom Ghaam | In this episode, we travel to Kannauj to discover how perfume and attar traders are turning flowers and mehendi into a crores-worth business. From traditional distillation to the world of luxury fragrances, explore the fascinating story of Kannauj's perfume industry.

programme.title: Daily Video
programme.desc: Outsiders will now need prior permission from the principal to enter government schools in Rajasthan, with photography and videography also requiring written approval . The move, citing student privacy and safety, has drawn criticism from the Opposition and CJP, who accuse the government of hiding the poor condition of schools .

programme.title: Daily Video
programme.desc: BJP national spokesperson Shehzad Poonawalla has once again resigned from the party, citing "pressing emergency financial and personal circumstances" in a letter to BJP President Nitin Nabin. He had previously offered to resign on July 30, but his resignation was not accepted then.

programme.title: Gurmat Vichar
programme.desc: Katha by Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji on GTC Punjabi Television presents a profound spiritual discourse rooted in the timeless wisdom of Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji. Renowned for his deep knowledge, powerful narration, and simple yet impactful explanations, Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji brings Gurbani to life by connecting its teachings with everyday human experiences. Through soulful storytelling, historical references, and meaningful interpretations of Gurbani, this Katha guides the Sangat towards self-reflection, humility, and spiritual awakening. Each session offers clarity on life's challenges while emphasizing the values of Naam Simran, Seva, truthful living, and unwavering faith in Waheguru.

programme.title: Shabad Amrit
programme.desc: Shabad Amrit is a soulful devotional songs slot dedicated to the divine verses of Gurbani. The segment features a curated selection of sacred Shabads and spiritual hymns that inspire peace, reflection, and inner harmony. Designed to create a serene and uplifting atmosphere, Shabad Amrit offers viewers a moment of calm amidst daily life, connecting them with spirituality through melodious renditions and meaningful lyrics. Rooted in devotion and reverence, the slot serves as a spiritual pause—where music becomes prayer and faith finds its voice.

programme.title: Desi Beatz

The show captures the essence of modern Punjab—where tradition meets contemporary sound—making it a perfect blend of rhythm, style, and desi swag. Designed for music lovers of all ages, Desi Beatz turns every moment into a celebration, whether it's party anthems, romantic hits, or viral sensations. Tune in to GTC Punjabi Television and stay connected with what's trending in Punjabi music—loud, lively, and full of desi energy.

programme.title: Surtaaj of Punjab
programme.desc: “Surtaaj of Punjab” is a vibrant Punjabi musical reality show on GTC Punjabi, celebrating the rich cultural heritage of Punjab through its aspiring singers. Hosted by Saira, Anmol Aulakh and Gurjeet Singh, the show features a diverse range of talent competing for the coveted title. Renowned music directors Gurmeet Singh and Jaidev Kumar (Music Director) along with celebrated singer Jyotika Tangri, serve as the esteemed judges, guiding contestants on a musical journey. Each episode is a celebration of talent, emotion, and the magic of Punjabi music.

programme.title: Markandeya Puranam by Vaddiparthi Padmakar
programme.desc: Markandeya Puranam, by Vaddiparthi Padmakar, presents the essence of the ancient Markandeya Purana in a simple and engaging manner. Through the story of Sage Markandeya, the work highlights the values of devotion, righteousness, self-discipline, and faith in divine justice. The book emphasizes moral living and spiritual wisdom, making traditional puranic teachings accessible and meaningful to modern readers.

programme.title: Dharma Sandehalu | Kakunuri Suryanarayana
programme.desc: Dharma Sandehalu preaches rational thinking and moral awareness by questioning traditional notions of dharma. Kakunuri Suryanarayana emphasizes that true dharma lies in justice, humanity, and ethical reasoning rather than blind faith or rigid customs. The work urges individuals to think critically, act responsibly, and align moral values with social progress and human welfare.

programme.title: Dharma Sandehalu by TKV Raghavan
programme.desc: Dharma Sandehalu by TKV Raghavan is a thoughtful and insightful show that addresses common doubts and questions related to dharma, life values, and ethical living. Through simple explanations, real-life examples, and spiritual wisdom, the program helps audiences understand how dharma applies to everyday situations. The show aims to guide viewers toward clarity, inner peace, and righteous living in a practical and relatable manner.

programme.title: Alapati Chamakkulu
programme.desc: Alapati Chamakkulu is a fun infotainment show that explores human relationships, lifestyle, and motivational themes. Blending humor with meaningful insights, the show presents relatable stories and real-life experiences that inspire, entertain, and connect with audiences across all age groups.

programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: Have a cheese lover coming over? Blow their minds with some of Spencer's "grate" barbecued cheese recipes! First up, Spencer chars Brie Cheese to an ooey-gooey perfection and tops it with tart cherries and crunchy walnuts, serving it with crispy grilled crostinis. Next up is a Grilled Steak and Caesar with a twist only Spencer could add - grilled... lettuce! Then, Spencer uses the classic German "hasselback" presentation to stuff chicken breasts with verdant spinach, yummy Swiss cheese and pungent sun- dried tomatoes, grilling them to melty perfection. Finally, Spencer fires up his barbecue to make his Grilled Peaches with Salted Bourbon Caramel, a decadent dessert elevated with creamy Mascarpone and perfectly balances sweet, smoky, and salty flavours.

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: Pork and the grill are good buddies and host Spencer Watts shows us four of his favourite pork recipes that will have you salivating.

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: Fun and quirky host Chef Spencer Watts kicks off this episode by showing off his knife skills as he sabres a pineapple to start his instant classic Grilled Fruit Salad. The pineapple joins a mix of bright summer fruits on the grill, then berries, spicy citrus vinaigrette and savoury feta cheese. Next up, Spencer whips up his Hawaiian Chicken recipe. Spiced with cayenne and Chinese five spice, Spencer stuffs flavourful chicken thighs with pineapple and grills it with a delightful ginger and soy sauce. Every bite is sweet, savoury, and fresh - exactly how summer should taste! Then Spencer shares his top tips for adding smoky flavours to pork using an easy and handy smoke pouch. His Apple Smoked Pork Tenderloin is bathed in a fog of applewood smoke and he then tops it with tart apple-blueberry compote. Cinnamon buns are amazing with a bit of orange peel - but have you ever had them in an orange peel and on the grill? That's right and Spencer shows you how you can make fun and flavourful Orange Peel Cinnamon Buns on the barbecue using indirect heat.

programme.title: CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: Halibut is on the menu for Craig Wong's first stop in this episode of CombiNATION Plates for his Icelandic tribute, the firm, flaky fish is served with Lovage, BeÌarnaise, and Beet Glazed Turnips. Next, it's a Jamaican adventure on a plate featuring whole, soft-shell crab Escovitch, fried, doused in chili vinegar, and served with carrot meringue?! Check out the common ingredient: ice cream! With creamy Skyr style with Blueberries representing Iceland and an Avocado Lime sensation for Jamaica that only Chef Wong could pull off, made in mere moments with liquid nitrogen! The Big Dish is a you-could-only-find-it-here experience Jamaican Jerk Spice Reindeer (yes, you read that right) served with Brown Stew Wild Mushrooms and Salsify.

programme.title: CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: If you are talking about Irish food, it's hard not to talk about Corned Beef and Cabbage. On this episode of CombiNATION Plates, Chef Craig Wong delivers his unusual take using Beef Cheek, modern technique, and a caraway-infused Carrot Terrine for fun! Next up is a tribute to Izakaya eats, featuring Tare Grilled Duck Hearts, Miso-roasted Mushroom, and Agedashi Tofu. The featured common ingredient is Oysters. For Ireland, it's Garlic GratineÌe for Japan, check out the Kaki Yaki, oysters broiled with miso and rich Japanese Kewpie mayo. For the final dish, light up! Smoking is permitted! Check out blowtorch-seared and tableside-smoked Wagyu Beef, brushed with Irish Stout Teriyaki and served with Wasabi Champ Potato. Now that's a CombiNation Plate!

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Filled with ruins in its bustling streets, the region of Lazio sticks with grandeur in all it does, including food! To introduce us to Lazio, Host Michael Bonacini highlights its Jewish influence with a crispy Roman Jewish-style Artichokes. As crunchy as a potato chip, Michael's artichokes are a delicious fried treat that are a perfect way to kick off a delicious meal. For his primo Michael brings together simple ingredients to create a rich Bucatini with Amatriciana Sauce. Michael's secondo turns what was once peasant food into a delectable and tender dish. Cooked with a blend of vegetables and sauce, Michael's Braised Oxtail brings forth the history of cuisine. Returning to Rome for his final dish, Michael cooks up the popular Sour Cherry and Ricotta Tart. With the tart cherries countered by the creamy ricotta, every decadent bite offers a world of taste.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Campania's beautiful coastline is filled with two things: tourists and seafood. Diving into the culture of the region, Celebrity Chef Michael Bonacini begins his meal with a salad from the Island of Capri. Putting a twist on the classic dish, Michael's Grilled Caprese Salad combines fresh tomatoes, tangy balsamic, and a hint of sweetness from basil. For his primo, Michael serves up bold flavours with his Spaghetti Puttanesca. Mixing salty and sweet, this sauce offers a delicious take on the typical plate of spaghetti. Looking to the coast for his secondo, Michael quickly cooks up aromatic and spicy Herb-stuffed Scallops and Grilled Broccoli Rabe. For his dolce Michael whips up a dessert made for a celebration: Rum Babas. Typically for special occasions, each bite of Rum Babas offers pure sweetness with a fresh citrus zest.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini delves into the Italian region of Emilia- Romagna to discover its iconic cuisine. To start, Michael stays light with an airy Mortadella Mousse spread on fluffy Modena Mini Flatbreads. Next, Michael cooks up Tortellini in Broth, a dish originally from Bologna that can be easily altered to personal taste. Michael chooses to fill his tortellini with a rich and savoury mixture of prosciutto, mortadella, and ground pork. For his secondo, Michael uses traditional ingredients and pairs them in a tart, luxurious dish of Duck Breast with Balsamic Cherry Sauce. To wind down his meal, Michael whips up a creamy classic, Rice Custard Cake topped with a Cherry Glaze.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini explores sweet and spicy dishes hailing from the coastal region of Calabria. For his antipasto, Michael cooks up a light and refreshing Brioche with Gelato. Fluffy brioche buns surround the sweet flavours of gelato for a delicious start to your meal. Switching to spice for the primo, Michael introduces a Spicy Sausage and Ricotta Pasta. Full of sweet, savoury, and spicy flavours, this dish provides a strong, flavourful meal sure to please any crowd. For his secondo, Michael goes for a hearty Lamb au Gratin with Peas and Asparagus a classic holiday dish that will warm any room. For his finale, Michael whips up a simple, yet impressive, Chocolate-covered Figs.

programme.title: The Illusionist
programme.desc: Vienna, seconda metà dell'Ottocento. L' acclamato illusionista Eisenheim incanta le platee con i suoi incredibili trucchi. Ha persino catturato l' interesse del Principe Leopoldo e della sua fidanzata Sophia, un tempo legata sentimentalmente allo stesso Eisenheim.

programme.title: La città verrà distrutta all'alba
programme.desc: Immaginate di vivere in una piccola città dove tutto è sicuro e felice... finché improvvisamente non lo è più. In un terrificante racconto del "Sogno Americano" andato terribilmente storto, quattro abitanti di Ogden Marsh, IA, si ritrovano intrappolati nella loro città natale.

programme.title: The Eye
programme.desc: Una ragazza cieca riceve un trapianto di cornea per tornare a vedere. Tuttavia, si accorge presto di poter vedere tutto... anche fantasmi inquietanti.

programme.title: Awake Anestesia cosciente
programme.desc: Sebbene il suo corpo sia completamente paralizzato dall'anestesia, Clay rimane consapevole per tutta la durata dell'intervento, sperimentando così la 'consapevolezza intraoperatoria'. Questa esperienza, tra il delirio e la realtà, avrà ripercussioni nella sua vita perché emergeranno segreti nascosti.

programme.title: Aftershock
programme.desc: Sulla costa cilena, la vacanza del turista americano Gringo, giunto in visita all'amico dopo aver divorziato, volge al meglio quando incontra un gruppo di tre belle turiste con cui andare a divertirsi. Quando però nel corso della notte un violento terremoto colpisce la zona e devasta ogni cosa compreso il nightclub sotterraneo in cui si stanno divertendo, il terrore prende il sopravvento.

programme.title: Crucifixion
programme.desc: Padre Dumitru e alcune suore compiono un violento esorcismo su suor Adelina, che si crede posseduta da un demone. A seguito della morte di quest'ultima, i suoi aguzzini vengono arrestati con l'accusa di omicidio. Nella capitale giunge Nicole, giornalista newyorchese, che vuole indagare sul caso.

programme.title: Ritorno a Romance
programme.desc: Zoe è una wedding planner di successo, ma suo padre le chiede aiuto al caffè di famiglia, lei torna felicemente nella sua città natale di Romance, nell'Oregon. Non sa che sua madre ha già assunto Will per aiutarla, un aspirante chef e, guarda caso, l'amore d'infanzia di Zoe! Le tensioni aumentano tra Zoe e Will, ma risolveranno le loro divergenze e troveranno l'amore perduto lungo la strada?

programme.title: Un Amore Indimenticabile
programme.desc: Lillian è una donna d'affari che trasforma le start-up in aziende di successo. Il suo ultimo cliente è una società chiamata "Love Subscription". Il passato doloroso di Lillian entrerà in conflitto con i suoi crescenti sentimenti per Grant, il fondatore di "Love Subscription"?

programme.title: Uno chalet per due
programme.desc: Una divorziata amante del Natale prenota uno chalet con sua madre e sua figlia per le vacanze, dove incontra uno scrittore che disprezza il Natale. Insieme imparano la magia del Natale e della famiglia.

programme.title: I consigli di zia Hope
programme.desc: Una giornalista che aspetta una svolta nella sua carriera viene inviata in una piccola cittadina di provincia per scrivere un articolo sul figlio del caporedattore, vincitore di un premio Pulitzer. Le loro visioni differenti sul mondo del giornalismo aiuteranno entrambi a capire cosa vogliono davvero dalla vita.

programme.title: La casa del cuore
programme.desc: Bradley, fotografo inglese, uccide un uomo per legittima difesa ed è, ricercato dalla polizia locale. Decide, quindi, di inoltrarsi nelle foreste selvagge della Birmania per fuggire ai controlli e continuare il suo reportage. Qui, viene catturato da un gruppo di indigeni che vivono allo stato brado. Costretto a lavorare per loro, si innamorerà, alla fine, di Maraya, figlia del capo tribù.

programme.title: Inaspettate passioni
programme.desc: Dopo una relazione finita, la giornalista Dana Willingham si ritrova sola e bloccata in un ritiro di yoga per coppie, mentre lo scoop più importante della sua carriera va in onda in sua assenza. E lo yoga nemmeno le piace! Ma forse l'universo l'ha messa qui per un motivo, perché l'affascinante solitario che soggiorna al rifugio si rivela essere Stefan Gonzales, il guru della technologia al centro dello scandalo. Mentre si guadagna la sua fiducia per smascherarlo, si scopre innamorata di lui. Ora deve usare le lezioni di yoga per scegliere: lo scoop perfetto o l'uomo perfetto?

programme.title: Date Movie
programme.desc: Parodia delle commedie romantiche che si concentra su una donna, il suo amante, i suoi genitori e suo padre.

programme.title: Ridatemi mia figlia
programme.desc: Dopo la scomparsa della figlia a seguito del successo dell'apertura del suo ristorante, Eve decide di prendere in mano la situazione e scoprire chi c'è dietro al rapimento.

programme.title: Matrimonio negli Hamptons
programme.desc: Jenna è una stilista che lavora per la boutique della sua amica. Il loro affare in difficoltà è stato salvato da un famoso influencer. Quando Jenna arriva a un sontuoso matrimonio nei Hamptons, viene scambiata per lei, ma decide di continuare a fingere per salvare l'attività.

programme.title: Banana Joe
programme.desc: Un uomo vive felicemente su un'isola con la sua famiglia, coltivando banane. Quando un gangster locale con un occhio sulla proprietà dell'uomo cerca di prendersela, deve andare in città per la prima volta a chiedere aiuto.

programme.title: Un appuntamento con il destino
programme.desc: Jack è uno scrittore in difficoltà i cui ideali di speranza sono stati soppressi dal rifiuto e dalla solitudine, ma la sua vita è destinata a cambiare in seguito all'incontro con Maria, una ragazza allegra e molto superstiziosa.

programme.title: Chalet Girl
programme.desc: Kim, da vero maschiaccio, è stata una campionessa di skateboard ma ha dovuto abbandonare i suoi sogni di gloria per trovare lavoro presso un fast food e mantenere se stessa e il padre.

programme.title: Una bugia per amore
programme.desc: Innamorato di una donna ebrea, un uomo decide di fingersi un membro della comunità ebraica allo scopo di conquistarla.

programme.title: L'amore sa dove trovarti
programme.desc: Emma, giovane Amish con il cuore pieno dei romanzi di Jane Austen, sogna una vita oltre i confini della sua comunità. Durante un'estate in Ohio, si ritrova sospesa tra due mondi e due amori: Noah, fedele alle radici, e Andy, un giornalista che le offre la libertà.

programme.title: Il fiume delle verità
programme.desc: In questa coinvolgente storia d'amore un ventenne ribelle abbandona casa per andare a vivere in solitudine sulle rive di un fiume bellissimo ma selvaggio e quello che trova non è solo se stesso ma anche il vero amore.

programme.title: My Policeman
programme.desc: Storia di un amore proibito e dell'evoluzione delle convenzioni sociali, My Policeman segue le relazioni tra tre persone — il poliziotto Tom, l'insegnante Marion e il curatore museale Patrick — e il loro percorso emotivo che si snoda nel corso di diversi decenni.

programme.title: Angeli Ribelli
programme.desc: Irlanda 1939. William Franklin unico insegnante laico in un collegio cattolico ha metodi di insegnamento diametralmente opposti a quelli esistenti, ancorati all'abuso verbale e fisico.

programme.title: Manhattan Nocturne
programme.desc: Dopo aver perso la sua unica figlia in un incidente, Griff Cole ha un crollo nervoso dopo una ubriacatura. 12 mesi dopo, termina il percorso di riabilitazione nell'anniversario della morte della figlia. Le successive 24 ore lo salveranno o lo distruggeranno.

programme.title: The Sparrow
programme.desc: Quando l'adolescente e pecora nera della famiglia Kevin provoca accidentalmente la morte del fratello maggiore Robbie, fa qualcosa di imperdonabile: tiene segreta la tragedia. Kevin deve guardare con orrore mentre le conseguenze della sua bugia prendono corpo.

programme.title: Una Stagione da Ricordare
programme.desc: Dopo la tragica morte della pallavolista Caroline "Line" Found, le sue compagne di squadra cercano conforto e sostegno nella loro amorevole allenatrice nella speranza di vincere il campionato.

programme.title: Latelier dei miei sogni
programme.desc: La stilista Skye si sposta con un "camion della moda"ma non può guidare il camion e gestire l'attività da sola. L'aiuto arriva sotto forma de Kevin. Mentre lavorano insieme, Skye e Kevin scoprono di avere più cose in comune di quanto pensassero...

programme.title: Le scarpe magiche di Natale
programme.desc: Noelle, che detesta il Natale, resta bloccata in un grande magazzino alla Vigilia. Qui incontra una donna che sostiene di essere il suo angelo custode e le fa vivere una esperienza simile a quella raccontata da 'Canto di natale' di Charles Dickens.

programme.title: Once Upon a Wedding
programme.desc: Una settimana prima del suo matrimonio, una donna ferisce un uomo in un incidente stradale. Mentre si prende cura di lui, inizia a dubitare di aver fatto le scelte giuste nella vita.

programme.title: Puoi baciare la damigella
programme.desc: Scarlett è un'influencer affermata di New York con una passione per la pasticceria. La ragazza, però, dovrà lasciare per breve tempo il suo nuovo impiego per prendere parte al matrimonio di sua sorella.

programme.title: Una festa da sogno
programme.desc: L'organizzatrice di eventi di New York Kelly è una delle migliori del settore. Ma quando Joe, un influente editore di siti web, la assume per organizzare il compleanno di sua nipote, Kelly si rende conto che potrebbe aver trovato la sua anima gemella.

programme.title: Vendemmia d'amore
programme.desc: L'avvocato Sarah Stein si occupa di un caso riguardante un'eredità ma tutti i famigliari litigano tra di loro.

programme.title: Un'estate da ricordare
programme.desc: Zoe e Luke volevano condividere il loro primo bacio ma furono interrotti. Quindici anni dopo si ritrovano.

programme.title: Un weekend d'agosto
programme.desc: Un incontro casuale con un affascinante sconosciuto capovolge il mondo perfetto di Katja.

programme.title: Un guaio di sorella
programme.desc: Klara deve vendere la fattoria e si rivolge alla sorella Mika, che vive nella grande città.

programme.title: Passioni e Desideri
programme.desc: Con un grande cast, girato tra Vienna, Londra, Parigi, New York, l'Arizona e Rio de Janeiro, il film racconta quanti incontri, opportunità, scelte e decisioni ci si presentano nel corso di una vita.

programme.title: La Finestra di Alice
programme.desc: Gabriele, aspirante scrittore pieno di debiti, passa le giornate a spiare dalla finestra la bella dirimpettaia Alice. Non riuscendo a sostenere le spese per il lussuoso appartamento avuto in eredità, il giovane decide di affittare una stanza allo spagnolo Fabio. La convivenza fra i due si rivela piuttosto complicata perché i ragazzi si scontrano spesso per via di grosse diversità caratteriali, ma poco dopo nel palazzo di Alice avviene un omicidio e Fabio diviene il principale indiziato.

programme.title: A Proposito di Noi
programme.desc: Sette personaggi, due storie. Si intrecciano all'interno di una scatola nera. I protagonisti si confessano in camera si odiano e si amano. Ognuno di loro è incastrato in un girotondo di emozioni ed è destinato a cadere per terra.

programme.title: Non ti posso dimenticare
programme.desc: Fred Astaire impersona un eroico pilota della seconda guerra mondiale innamorato di una dattilografa la quale, ignara del suo valore, lo disprezza credendolo un imboscato. Alla fine la donna scoprirà la verità.

programme.title: L'imperdibile viaggio di Harold Fry
programme.desc: Harold è un uomo qualunque che ha sempre vissuto senza prendere iniziative. Un giorno scopre che una vecchia amica è molto malata e decide di andarla a trovare attraversando a piedi l'Inghilterra.

programme.title: Tutto Ciò che Voglio
programme.desc: Wendy è Autistica, viene aiutata dalla terapia della struttura specializzata di Scottie, proteggendo la sua rigida routine quotidiana e permettendo che la ragazza coltivi la sua passione, ovvero la visione della saga televisiva Star Trek.

programme.title: Un affare di famiglia
programme.desc: Dopo una delle loro sessioni di taccheggio, Osamu e il figlio si imbattono in una bambina lasciata al freddo. Seppur dapprima riluttante, la moglie di Osamu accetta di prendersene cura dopo avere appreso le difficoltà che la piccola deve affrontare. Sebbene la famiglia sia povera e guadagni solo lo stretto necessario per sopravvivere, tutti sono felici finché un incidente imprevisto porta alla luce segreti tenuti ben nascosti, mettendo alla prova ogni legame.

programme.title: American Life
programme.desc: La storia di Burt e Verona, una coppia di trentenni che aspetta un bambino. La gravidanza procede bene fino a quando ricevono una notizia improvvisa e sconvolgente: gli eccentrici genitori di Burt annunciano che lasceranno il Colorado per trasferirsi in Europa. A questo punto, viene a cadere l'unica ragione per la quale avevano deciso di stabilirsi lì. Dove e vicino a chi dovranno mettere si casa per crescere il bambino in arrivo? I due ragazzi partono così per un viaggio che li porterà a far visita ad amici e familiari, in città diverse, per valutare tutte le possibili opzioni.

programme.title: Ishtar
programme.desc: Warren Beatty e Dustin Hoffman trovano l'avventura, l'amore e il divertimento nella strada verso ISHTAR.

programme.title: Fratellastri A 40 Anni
programme.desc: Dopo il grande successo di Talladega Nights: The Ballad of Ricky Bobby, Will Ferrell e John C. Reilly sono di nuovo insieme come due quarantenni scansafatiche, ciascuno ancora in casa con uno dei genitori. Quando i rispettivi genitori si innamorano e si sposano, i due sono obbligati a convivere come fratellastri in questa esilarante commedia prodotta da Judd Apatow (Superbad).

programme.title: Tutte le ex del mio ragazzo
programme.desc: Brittany Murphy catturerà il vostro cuore in questo divertentissimo film su una brava ragazza che non ne combina una giusta. Assunta per lavorare in un talk show televisivo, la vita di Stacy Holt è stravolta quando viene convinta ad esplorare uno dei temi del programma e controlla l'agenda del suo ragazzo. Ma si è dimenticata una cosa: nel mondo della TV, c'è sempre una sorpresa scioccante dietro l'angolo -- e lei ne avrà una bella grande!

programme.title: Furto di sera bel colpo si spera
programme.desc: Quinto, ladro sfortunato, passa dalle auto ai salumi e ai quadri, finendo sempre in ospedale o in galera

programme.title: Sesso e volentieri
programme.desc: Dieci piccoli episodi collegati dal filo rosso del ""sesso e volentieri""

programme.title: La governante
programme.desc: La nuova governante francese Caterina Leher sconvolge la famiglia Platania, portando caos e tragedie

programme.title: Il lumacone
programme.desc: Gianni, cuoco solo e abbandonato, realizza il sogno di un ristorante in un vagone grazie a Ginetto.

programme.title: American Carnage
programme.desc: Una nuova legge permette l' arresto dei figli di immigrati irregolari. Per evitare il carcere i giovani hanno una sola opportunità: fare volontariato in una misteriosa casa di cura fornendo assistenza agli anziani.

programme.title: Attenti a quelle due
programme.desc: Josephine Chesterfield (Anne Hathaway) è una britannica affascinante e seducente con un debole per la frode di uomini ricchi creduloni. Nel suo mondo ben ordinato scoppia Penny Rust (Rebel Wilson), un australiano che è in forma libera e amante del divertimento come Josephine è calcolata e astuta.

programme.title: Se permetti non parlarmi di bambini!
programme.desc: Da quando si è separato, Gabriel non ha fatto altro che dedicarsi a sua figlia Sofia. Un giorno si presenta al suo negozio di musica Vicky, una donna del passato, oggi più affascinante che mai. A lei però i bambini non piacciono affatto.

programme.title: La programmazione riprenderà a breve
programme.desc: Ci stiamo concedendo un sonno riparatore per tornare più belli di prima! Resta sintonizzato e presto arriveranno altre proposte straordinarie di intrattenimento a cura di Rakuten TV.

programme.title: La programmazione riprenderà a breve
programme.desc: Ci stiamo concedendo un sonno riparatore per tornare più belli di prima! Resta sintonizzato e presto arriveranno altre proposte straordinarie di intrattenimento a cura di Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Tutto a posto e niente in ordine
programme.desc: Un gruppo di meridionali, immigrati a Milano, affittano un appartamento. Gino, dopo vari sforzi per cercare un lavoro onesto, si dà alla malavita. Carletto diventa cuoco, Biky e Adelina fanno le cameriere, Isotta finisce su un marciapiede. Sante, un siciliano, in breve diventa padre di sette figli.

programme.title: Gatto nero, gatto bianco
programme.desc: Due giovani si vogliono bene, ma le loro famiglie si oppongono. È solo il pretesto per tutto il resto di questo film unico. Il Kusturica più vero, e Leone d'Argento a Venezia

programme.title: Restiamo Amici
programme.desc: Alessandro viene improvvisamente contattato, dal Brasile, dal suo vecchio amico Gigi. In punto di morte, l'uomo ha un ultimo favore: per ereditare i tre milioni di euro che gli ha lasciato suo padre deve intestarli a suo figlio. Ma Gigi non ha eredi.

programme.title: 10 Cose Da Fare Prima Di Lasciarsi
programme.desc: Ben e Abigail si conoscono a un appuntamento al buio in un bar e, per gioco, stilano una lista delle dieci cose da fare insieme prima di lasciarsi. Dopo aver passato la notte insieme, le cose prendono una piega inaspettata.

programme.title: Alaska
programme.desc: Un californiano insoddisfatto accoglie con gioia la notizia di un'eredità che lo attende in Alaska. Ma per impadronirsene deve purtroppo affrontare una prova molto dura.

programme.title: Lillo e Greg: The Movie
programme.desc: Una collezione antologica delle migliori scenette comiche firmate da Lillo e Greg, in compagnia di tanti famosi colleghi. Un concentrato di ironia e musica dai tratti surreali e farseschi.

programme.title: Ercole contro Roma
programme.desc: Tra rivolte, tradimenti e scontri spettacolari, Ercole affronta Roma per difendere il suo popolo e ristabilire la giustizia.

programme.title: La furia di Ercole
programme.desc: Tra magie oscure, battaglie e tradimenti, Ercole affronta forze nemiche per liberare il regno e salvare chi ama.

programme.title: La rivolta dei mercenari
programme.desc: In un territorio sconvolto dalla ribellione, un gruppo di spietati mercenari viene ingaggiato per reprimere una rivolta, ma tradimenti e ambizioni personali accendono una lotta feroce per il potere.

programme.title: I Pirati della Malesia
programme.desc: Tra esotiche terre d'Oriente, il leggendario Sandokan guida i suoi uomini contro il dominio coloniale, tra battaglie navali e avventure senza sosta. Diretto da Umberto Lenzi, con Steve Reeves.

programme.title: Ettore Fieramosca
programme.desc: Nell'Italia rinascimentale, il valoroso Ettore Fieramosca guida i cavalieri italiani nella celebre sfida contro i francesi, tra onore, rivalità e spirito patriottico.

programme.title: Arizona Colt
programme.desc: Il bandito Gordo libera alcuni prigionieri costringendoli a unirsi alla sua banda o a morire. Arizona Colt rifiuta e si dirige verso Blackstone City, dove Gordo pianifica una rapina. Dopo l'uccisione della ragazza del saloon Dolores da parte di un suo uomo, Arizona accetta di dare la caccia all'assassino in cambio di denaro e dell'aiuto di Jane.

programme.title: W Django!
programme.desc: Django è sulle tracce di alcuni fuorilegge rinnegati che hanno violentato e ucciso sua moglie. Durante il viaggio, salva un ladro di cavalli da un'improvvisa impiccagione. Scopre che l'uomo sa chi ha commesso l'omicidio. Gli uomini si uniscono e si dirigono a ovest per vendicarsi.

programme.title: Il venditore di morte
programme.desc: Il pistolero Silver viene assunto da un avvocato per dimostrare che il suo cliente, Chester Conway, è innocente della rapina al saloon per cui è stato condannato all'impiccagione.

programme.title: Alleluja e Sartana figli di... Dio
programme.desc: Due artisti della truffa finiscono per aiutare i membri di una chiesa di provincia a non perdere i loro soldi a causa di una banda di truffatori.

programme.title: Giù le mani... carogna!
programme.desc: Il leggendario pistolero Django sta raccontando alcune delle sue più grandi avventure mentre era seduto in un saloon.

programme.title: I tre del Colorado
programme.desc: Per contrastare i soprusi degli inglesi, la popolazione locale cattura la figlia di un industriale.

programme.title: Il mio nome è Scopone e faccio sempre cappotto
programme.desc: Dallas e Kelly, in gara per un ranch, affrontano i fratelli Wright e altri rivali.

programme.title: ...e poi lo chiamarono il Magnifico
programme.desc: Joe, che non ama la violenza, affronta il selvaggio West per esaudire l'ultimo desiderio del padre.

programme.title: Il mercenario
programme.desc: Un mercenario polacco e un minatore guidano una rivoluzione contro il governo oppressivo del Messico.

programme.title: Hot Corn Cine News Ep.8
programme.desc: Tutte le news che vi siete persi dalla redazione di HotCorn: tra ospiti, interviste e grandi novità al cinema.

programme.title: Stelle del Grande Schermo
programme.desc: La serie che celebra i grandi attori degli ultimi 90 anni.

programme.title: Hot Corn Cine News Ep.8
programme.desc: Tutte le news che vi siete persi dalla redazione di HotCorn: tra ospiti, interviste e grandi novità al cinema.

programme.title: Pazzi da Amare
programme.desc: L'arrivo di una nuova persona sconvolge gli equilibri di una famiglia spezzata.

programme.title: La Rivincita dei Supereroi
programme.desc: Da Batman a Black Panther: la storia dei supereroi che hanno conquistato il cinema.

programme.title: The thieves
programme.desc: Una infame banda di cinque ladri coreani, guidati da Popie, riceve un'offerta irresistibile da Macao Park, un ex partner: rubare la "lacrima del sole", un diamante di 318 carati dal valore di 20 milioni di dollari, nascosto in un casinò di Macao.

programme.title: Operation Red Sea
programme.desc: La squadra di assalto Jiaolong, una delle forze speciali della marina cinese, riceve come compito altamente pericoloso quello di far evacuare i residenti cinesi da una repubblica nordafricana in cui è in corso un colpo di stato.

programme.title: Time
programme.desc: Seh-hee e Ji-woo stanno insieme da due anni e sono molto innamorati. Ma con il passare del tempo Seh-hee inizia a temere che Ji-woo possa stancarsi di lei e diventa isterica ogni volta che l'uomo degna di attenzione un'altra.

programme.title: La programmazione riprenderà a breve
programme.desc: Ci stiamo concedendo un sonno riparatore per tornare più belli di prima! Resta sintonizzato e presto arriveranno altre proposte straordinarie di intrattenimento a cura di Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: Fong è un ladro che ha il vizio del gioco. L'occasione per fare un po' di soldi si presenta quando un magnate gli offre l'incarico di rapire un bambino. L'uomo accetta, ma l'unico problema è che deve prendersi cura del piccolo per qualche giorno.

programme.title: Remember me
programme.desc: Tyler e Ally, due cuori segnati dal dolore, trovano l'amore ma i segreti li separano.

programme.title: Duetto a tre
programme.desc: anley e Michael, durante un appuntamento, si ritrovano a trascorrere la serata con un barbone.
